title: George Carty
clean_html:
George Carty

Preserved Primary Document • carty-g.htm

George Thomas Carty, the son of William and Elizabeth Carty, was born in Ridgely, Caroline Co., MD on 8 March, 1827. Sometime before 1866 he married Lena (last name possibly MOSLEY?). They had at least 4 children: Emma Carty (b.1866) William Carty (b.1868) Rosella Carty (b.1870) George Washington Carty (26 January 1871 - 2 March, 1954) married Sarah Bell CARNEY They had the following children: George Elwood Carter (1900-1971) married Rheba Edith Carter George died in Kent Co., DE.
